sources.name: gallery
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; cd "$D" && printf '['; s=''; for f in $(ls -t *.jpg 2>/dev/null | head -30); do m=$(tr -d '\n' < "${f%.jpg}.json" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$m" ] || m=null; printf '%s{"n":"%s","m":%s}' "$s" "$f" "$m"; s=,; done; printf ']'

sources.name: dl
sources.cmd:
D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; w=2560; h=1440; hd="$D/.hdr.$$"; t="$D/.dl.$$.tmp"; if curl -sfL -m 25 -D "$hd" -o "$t" "https://picsum.photos/$w/$h"; then id=$(tr -d '' < "$hd" | sed -n 's/^[Pp]icsum-id: *//p' | tail -1); [ -n "$id" ] || id=x; b="$id-$(date +%s)"; mv "$t" "$D/$b.jpg"; info=$(curl -s -m 10 "https://picsum.photos/id/$id/info" | tr -d '
'); case "$info" in '{'*) ;; *) info=null;; esac; printf '{"source":"picsum.photos","id":"%s","downloaded":"%s","width":%d,"height":%d,"bytes":%d,"info":%s}
' "$id" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" $w $h "$(wc -c < "$D/$b.jpg")" "$info" > "$D/$b.json"; else rm -f "$t" "$hd"; echo 'download failed: check that this box can reach picsum.photos' >&2; exit 1; fi; rm -f "$hd"; f=$(cd "$D" && ls -t *.jpg | head -1); command -v hatch >/dev/null || { echo 'the hatch command is not on the server PATH; install it (install.sh) or set the background by hand' >&2; exit 1; }; hatch set background "$D/$f" --state {{state}} >/dev/null || exit 1; (cd "$D" && ls -t *.jpg 2>/dev/null | tail -n +31 | while read -r o; do rm -f "$o" "${o%.jpg}.json"; done); cd "$D" && printf '['; s=''; for f in $(ls -t *.jpg 2>/dev/null | head -30); do m=$(tr -d '
' < "${f%.jpg}.json" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$m" ] || m=null; printf '%s{"n":"%s","m":%s}' "$s" "$f" "$m"; s=,; done; printf ']'

sources.name: pick
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; case "$HATCH_ARG" in *.jpg) ;; *) echo 'not a .jpg image' >&2; exit 1;; esac; [ -f "$D/$HATCH_ARG" ] || { echo "no such image: $HATCH_ARG" >&2; exit 1; }; f="$HATCH_ARG"; command -v hatch >/dev/null || { echo 'the hatch command is not on the server PATH; install it (install.sh) or set the background by hand' >&2; exit 1; }; hatch set background "$D/$f" --state {{state}} >/dev/null || exit 1; printf '{"set":"%s"}' "$f"

sources.name: del
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; case "$HATCH_ARG" in *.jpg) ;; *) echo 'not a .jpg image' >&2; exit 1;; esac; [ -f "$D/$HATCH_ARG" ] || { echo "no such image: $HATCH_ARG" >&2; exit 1; }; rm -f "$D/$HATCH_ARG" "$D/${HATCH_ARG%.jpg}.json"; cd "$D" && printf '['; s=''; for f in $(ls -t *.jpg 2>/dev/null | head -30); do m=$(tr -d '\n' < "${f%.jpg}.json" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$m" ] || m=null; printf '%s{"n":"%s","m":%s}' "$s" "$f" "$m"; s=,; done; printf ']'
